text: El Salvador's president says a missile strike destroyed the headquarters of Haitian gang 400 Mawozo. The claim comes from the Salvadoran side; independent confirmation of the strike and its effects is not yet in the tracker.

judge.comment: Single-party claim, correctly attributed. A human should check whether independent confirmation has appeared before posting.

factChecks.claim: El Salvador's president says a missile strike destroyed 400 Mawozo headquarters

factChecks.source: tracker digest and event title give only the Salvadoran claim

text: How much Russian refining capacity is offline? Ukraine's General Staff put it at 42.74% in July 2026. The IEA said losses were "more than 20%" at peak. Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3–6%, as undamaged refineries offset losses.

judge.comment: Genuine sourced disagreement presented without adjudication. The Reuters figure has no as-of date in the tracker, so a human should confirm it.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine's General Staff put disabled capacity at 42.74% in July 2026
factChecks.source: tracker dispute 'How much Russian refining capacity has actually been disabled?'

factChecks.claim: IEA said losses were more than 20% at peak
factChecks.source: tracker dispute 'How much Russian refining capacity has actually been disabled?'

factChecks.claim: Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3–6%
factChecks.source: tracker dispute; no as-of date given for the Reuters figure

text: US envoys met Putin in the Kremlin on Nov 12 after the Abu Dhabi talks. Russia and Ukraine agreed in principle to a large prisoner swap (up to 1,500 each was discussed on Nov 10); Moscow has raised territorial demands.

judge.comment: Significant diplomatic development, every claim traces to tracker events dated Nov 10-12. Wording stays within what is reported.

factChecks.claim: US envoys met Putin in the Kremlin on Nov 12
Russia and Ukraine agreed in principle to a large prisoner swap
Up to 1,500 prisoners each discussed on Nov 10

text: An Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital killed at least six on Nov 12, Gaza civil defence says. The ceasefire-period toll stood at 1,613 killed as of Nov 10, with 20 killed in the past week. Figures are from Gaza authorities.

judge.comment: Casualty figures are attributed to Gaza civil defence and authorities rather than stated as independently verified. Sensitive topic, so wording stays minimal.

factChecks.claim: Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital kills at least six, per Gaza civil defence
Ceasefire-period toll 1,613 killed as of Nov 10

text: A Super El Niño has been declared as forecasters warn of major shifts in winter weather. Tracker data: Niño 3.4 anomaly +3.3°C (week centered Oct 14); 98% probability of a very strong event peaking Oct-Dec 2026.

judge.comment: Declaration and both KPIs are in tracker data with dates. Probability is presented as a forecast, not an observation.

factChecks.claim: Niño 3.4 SST anomaly +3.3°C, week centered Oct 14
98% probability of very strong El Niño peaking Oct-Dec 2026
